description: Repository validation support only. Case identities are planned expectations, not claims that tests are registered or executed. This independent protocol does not alter RuntimeMemorySafety receipt schemas.

statusPolicy.passRule: Each finding requires all its required cases and every integrated gate to pass with actual final-install identity and linked raw evidence. A missing prerequisite, empty case selection, forced termination or missing receipt cannot pass.
statusPolicy.executionClaimRule: A case identity becomes an executed test claim only when a receipt maps it to the actual executable/filter/test name and observed assertions.

supplementary: Requested capability flags without actual observations
Deterministic device-loss policy observations as GPU substitutes
prohibitedPassSubstitutes: Forced VK_NOT_READY for actual fence status
Simulated device loss for host GPU failure
Source-copy binaries for verified install closure
Historical or stale hashes for final-byte acceptance

prerequisites.requirement: Exact source revision, drift and user-owned changes recorded before edits
Immutable unchanged compiled/installed runtime and tool closure with SHA-256 manifests
Successful integrated compile/install and complete hashed runnable closure
Installed native tests and registered nonempty case selection
Bundled independent PNG decoder with CRC/Adler integrity enabled
Initialized existing bounded ThreadPool with actual worker observations
Actual supported Vulkan adapter and usable native target
Actually enabled Vulkan validation layer and retained callback log
Installed editor, bundled managed assets and usable desktop/offscreen target
Installed process-tree watchdog and fresh isolated evidence/work roots
Immutable authored workload controls, normalization map and actual worker counts
Three reference A/A pairs per scale and predeclared median/p95 thresholds
Committed frozen occurrence inventory, exact source hashes and batch copies
Native lexer self-tests and fail-closed symbol/token scanner

supplementaryEvidence: Source scans, comments and architecture review may support interpretation but do not replace required behavioral, GPU, parity or timing evidence.

findings.name: Defined fixed-pool ownership rejection
findings.completionRule: Defined foreign-value rejection without state change, valid destruction/reuse and constructor rollback.
supplementaryEvidence: Source scans, comments and architecture review may support interpretation but do not replace required behavioral, GPU, parity or timing evidence.

findings.name: Behavioral readback ownership evidence
findings.completionRule: Production ownership survives client terminal outcomes until valid retirement proof; actual GPU acceptance is mandatory.
supplementaryEvidence: Source scans, comments and architecture review may support interpretation but do not replace required behavioral, GPU, parity or timing evidence.

findings.name: Reviewable renderer and animation stages
findings.completionRule: Small coherent stages preserve sealed parity, scheduling, borrower lifetimes and calibrated timing.
supplementaryEvidence: Source scans, comments and architecture review may support interpretation but do not replace required behavioral, GPU, parity or timing evidence.

findings.name: Useful production comments
findings.completionRule: All frozen filler occurrences resolved with meaningful intent retained and token-equivalent comment-only patches.
supplementaryEvidence: Source scans, comments and architecture review may support interpretation but do not replace required behavioral, GPU, parity or timing evidence.
